regions.name: Brain & sleep
regions.function: Controls mood, focus, memory and reaction time. It recovers during sleep.

regions.name: Eyes
regions.function: Vision. Fluid shift in weightlessness can change the shape of the eye (SANS).

regions.name: Heart & vessels
regions.function: Pumps blood and oxygen around your body. Adapts quickly to changes in gravity.

regions.name: Lungs
regions.function: Bring oxygen in and carry CO₂ out. Sensitive to cabin air quality and dust.

regions.name: Bones & muscles
regions.function: Hold you up and move you. Without gravity they lose strength unless you exercise.

regions.name: Gut & metabolism
regions.function: Turns food into energy and controls blood sugar.

regions.name: Skin & immune
regions.function: Your first defence against germs. The immune system can weaken in space.

regions.name: Whole body (radiation)
regions.function: Radiation passes through every tissue, so its dose is tracked for the whole body.
